top_signals.title: Balancing Conviction and Risk: Masters in Business  with Maria Vassalou
top_signals.summary: Barry speaks with Maria Vassalou, Head of the Pictet Research Institute.  They discuss her research into global markets, and how they balance geopolitical risk. They also discuss China's growth as a technical innovator, and the risks to US debt. Finally, Barry and Maria discuss the differences between investing research and academia.  (Source: Bloomberg)
